positionFrames.text: Apply the selected idea to what the reader has actually described. Identify the relevant context, resource or way of understanding the question.
Examine a distinction, trade-off, constraint or competing consideration. It may already be managed; this position does not require a problem.
Develop an available perspective, option or method. Explain how it could help the reader explore the question without predicting an outcome.

fallback.synthesis: Consider these perspectives alongside the purpose and conditions described in the question. An existing strength can remain the starting point; a different approach is worth considering only where it serves that purpose.
fallback.action: One optional exercise is to compare the current approach with a small alternative using the same stated goal. Note what each would preserve, require and help clarify. The differences can inform whether any change is worthwhile.
